narrative.overview: A formal but personal digital memorial in which portraits lead, layered neutral blacks create a classic funeral field, and silver and white preserve hierarchy and readability.
keyCharacteristics: Portrait-led compositions with protected text zones
Strong black, charcoal, grey, silver, and white hierarchy
Flat sharp outlined actions with centred uppercase labels

rules.name: Monochrome Signal
rules.body: Silver marks remembrance, active state, or contribution, while white is reserved for primary reading and hover inversion.

rules.name: The Name Has Space
rules.body: The portrait fades fully to black before the display line begins on mobile.

rules.name: Structural Depth
rules.body: Use a divider or tonal step before adding shadow.

dos: Do preserve the black-to-image fade at every viewport.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets and visible keyboard focus.
Do let one decisive portrait lead the first screen.
donts: Don't make the site look like a generic corporate landing page or cheerful lifestyle brand.
Don't place text over a visually busy face or allow disconnected image panels.
Don't add ornamental effects that compete with the subject.
